messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SLO alert: Streaming p99 latency breach in us-west-2. p99=2.9s (SLO=1.2s), spike started ~1765432000. Affected: streaming endpoints, some tail stalls. Auto-group=id=inc-1765432100 :rotating_light:
sam: seeing it on dashboards too. p95 up from 300ms -> 1.1s, p99 way up. looks correlated with high KV eviction rate on shard-17. :eyes:
leah: @sam can you post the quick state? eviction rate / slab usage?
sam: eviction rate ~ 6k/s (normal ~800/s), slab fill 98% on shard-17, fragmentation high. prefill queue latency increasing. streaming tails aligning with prefill worker CPU spikes.
maria: Paging rate also spiking, I see many decode tasks queued waiting on KV fetch. Predecode vs decode imbalance: prefill > decode ~ 3:1, prefill is starving decode threads and generating eviction churn.
tony: is there a customer-visible spike? any error rates?
sam: 2 customers reported degraded streaming responsiveness, no increased 5xx. Mostly high token-latency and stalls. Not a full outage but SLO breach and UX impact.
sre-lead: ok plan: 1) short-term throttle prefill, 2) reduce prefill concurrency on shard-17, 3) route new streaming sessions to spare pool in us-west-2, 4) if needed, roll prefill-workers with updated eviction tuning. Assigning tasks.
leah: I'll take routing + canary. tony, can you drop prefill concurrency?
tony: on it. scaling prefill concurrency down 50% on shard-17. running admin command now:
```
# throttle prefill concurrency for shard-17
curl -s -X POST "https://admin.internal/redwood/prefill/tune" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"shard":"shard-17","concurrency":0.5}'
```
tony: command returned 200. prefill concurrency reported at ~52% of previous.
maria: reducing prefill is lowering eviction pressure already, slab fill dropped to 93% and eviction rate down to ~1.2k/s. decode queue backlog decreasing. p95 back to ~420ms.
sam: starting a short reroute to spare-pool-2 for streaming sessions in us-west-2. will do canary 5% then 20% if stable.
leah: can you show the reroute step?
sam: running:
```
# add routing rule: region us-west-2, traffic 5% -> spare-pool-2 for streaming
redwoodctl routes create --region us-west-2 --match "type:streaming" --dest spare-pool-2 --pct 5
```
sam: canary at 5% applied. monitoring p99 for canary sessions.
ops-bot: Canary update: 5% routed to spare-pool-2. No errors observed in canary for 2m.
leah: raise to 20% now if stable.
sam: bumped to 20%. p99 for main pool improving, overall p99 down to 1.6s.
leah: good. next mitigation: restart a subset of prefill-workers on shard-17 with new eviction threshold (increase min slab eviction size) to reduce fragmentation. sam can you prepare rollout command?
sam: preparing a rolling restart with new config flag `--min-evict-bytes=8mb` for prefill-workers. will do 10% at a time.

```
# rollout example
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/prefill-workers MIN_EVICT_BYTES=8388608
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/prefill-workers --selector shard=17 --max-unavailable=10%
```

sam: started rollout. first batch healthy. eviction rate edge down further.
tony: telemetry shows streaming stalls count dropping. p99 now ~1.25s. still above SLO but trending in right direction.
maria: customers in the affected cohort still see occasional stalls; recommend enabling fallback-model-routing for long polls: route to lower-RAM variant that doesn't pressure KV.
sre-lead: agree, enable fallback for sessions >30s. sam, can you apply a fallback rule?
sam: adding fallback rule:
```
redwoodctl sessions update --match "type:streaming && duration>30s" --fallback model=compact-4b
```
sam: rule applied. monitoring.
leah: team, we're going to classify this as Sev3 SLO breach with multi-customer impact. continuing mitigations; if metrics stay steady we'll transition to postmortem. handing off remaining monitoring to night oncall @leah in 30m.
sam: noted. I'll leave the routing and prefill tuning in place and add playbook steps to the incident doc.
maria: adding quick customer-impact notes: 3 enterprise customers reported perceivable lag, tickets filed INC-5012/5013/5014.
ops-bot: Autoscaling logs: prefill workers scaled down 48% after throttle; memory pressure reduced on shard-17.
sre-lead: thanks everyone — we'll keep observing. @leah ack and take over in 30m. If p99 creeps back up, escalate to infra and consider temporary read-through cache bypass for long polls.
leah: ack. leaving detailed handoff: mitigations applied, routing at 20% spare-pool, prefill concurrency -50%, rolling restart with MIN_EVICT_BYTES=8mb applied to shard-17, fallback routing for >30s sessions. monitoring links: https://dashboards.internal/streams/shard-17 and https://alerts.internal/alerts/1765432100
sam: leaving logs and short runbook in the incident thread. good job team. :thumbsup:
leah: taking over monitoring. will ping if we need further action. :zzz:
